Class Ansi

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.shell.Ansi
public final class Ansi extends Object
The Ansi class holds the VT100 color and cursor sequences the shell writes. A sequence is a short string of control bytes. The class does not choose which mode the terminal is in. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#Ansi

    • cuu

      public static String cuu(int n)
      The method returns the cursor-up sequence for n rows. A count of 0 or less returns an empty string. A positive count returns ESC [ n A.
      Parameters:
      n - The count is the number of rows to move up.
      Returns:
      The return value is the control sequence, or an empty string when the count is not positive.

    • cud

      public static String cud(int n)
      The method returns the cursor-down sequence for n rows. A count of 0 or less returns an empty string. A positive count returns ESC [ n B.
      Parameters:
      n - The count is the number of rows to move down.
      Returns:
      The return value is the control sequence, or an empty string when the count is not positive.

    • cuf

      public static String cuf(int n)
      The method returns the cursor-forward sequence for n columns. A count of 0 or less returns an empty string. A positive count returns ESC [ n C.
      Parameters:
      n - The count is the number of columns to move forward.
      Returns:
      The return value is the control sequence, or an empty string when the count is not positive.

    • cub

      public static String cub(int n)
      The method returns the cursor-back sequence for n columns. A count of 0 or less returns an empty string. A positive count returns ESC [ n D.
      Parameters:
      n - The count is the number of columns to move back.
      Returns:
      The return value is the control sequence, or an empty string when the count is not positive.

    • dl

      public static String dl(int n)
      The method returns the delete-lines sequence for n lines at the cursor. Lines below the cursor shift up. A count of 0 or less returns an empty string. A positive count returns ESC [ n M.
      Parameters:
      n - The count is the number of lines to delete.
      Returns:
      The return value is the control sequence, or an empty string when the count is not positive.

    • kv

      public static String kv(String key, String value)
      The method builds a status line in the form key: value. The key is bright green. The value is hot pink. A null key or a null value becomes an empty string. The result has no carriage return.
      Parameters:
      key - The key is the label on the left.
      value - The value is the text on the right.
      Returns:
      The return value is the colored line without a line ending.

    • replyHeader

      public static String replyHeader(String stamp, String model, int columns)
      The method builds a two-row dim box whose inner text is the clock text, a middle dot, and the model id. The clock text uses the form yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. A width below 24 becomes 80. A null clock text or a null model becomes empty. The inner text is shortened by dropping characters from the end of the model until it fits. If it still does not fit, the inner text itself is cut. The top row is a box edge around that text. The bottom row is a box edge of the full width. Each row ends with a carriage return and a line feed.
      Parameters:
      stamp - The clock text is the time in the form yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
      model - The model is the live model id.
      columns - The column count is the terminal width.
      Returns:
      The return value is two colored rows, each ended by a carriage return and a line feed.
